security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https: http:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Fast, lightweight cross-platform QR Code Generator & Designer
bundle.longDescription: ChromaQR is a high-performance desktop QR code studio built with Tauri v2 and Astro, featuring real-time 60fps preview, WCAG contrast scannability validation, custom gradients, embedded logos, and multi-format export.
